item.description:
# 0.36.9
- Group search, Active / All / Pinned / Archived navigation, and tool and project filters above the session list. - Preserve the search query and open terminal when switching session scopes. - Offer Search all sessions when an Active search has no results, keeping the query intact. - Hide navigation counts when the sidebar is too narrow to fit them; retain readable text labels and accessible counts.
Corresponding source, including pinned Swift package dependency sources and build scripts, is provided in `RunHuddle-0.36.9-source.tar.gz` alongside this installer. See docs/BUILDING.md and docs/LICENSING.md in that archive.
